lesson-intro.text: Here is the whole town in one house: a tiled roof, a striped awning, a table out front. It's the café on the corner. Watch it go up, floor by floor, then pull up a chair.

peak.text: Begin at the very top with a ball. A band slopes down to the left, and four short lines cut it into tiles.

roof.text: The roof slopes down from the ball and runs to a round tip. Add its top, two wall lines and a long band.

side-wall.text: Below the band, the corner runs down, along the ground and up to the roof's tip. Two windows, each on a ledge.

chimney.text: Next, the chimney: a short side up from the roof, a flat cap, and a second side below. Two pots stand on top.

roof-lines.text: Close the roof from the chimney to the tip. Three wavy lines slope down it, and one runs along the bottom.

tiles-top.text: Four bumps make the top row of tiles. Each one bridges two wavy lines.

tiles-middle.text: Then four more bumps, one row lower.

flower-box.text: On the front wall, a long flower box. Two bumpy bushes grow in it, with a short line between them.

window.text: Behind the bushes, an arched window: a big arch, a smaller one inside, and a cross of two bars.

awning.text: The awning hangs from the long band: two sides, a fold line and a wavy hem of seven bumps.

stripes.text: Six slanting lines divide the awning into seven stripes, right down to the hem.

shop-window.text: Under the awning, the shop's left side and a post. Then the big window, with a cross of two bars.

door.text: Right of the window, the door: its frame, a tall pane of glass and a square panel. A line along the ground.

table.text: Out front, a small round table: a flat oval top on one leg that spreads into a foot.

chairs.text: A chair on each side: a rounded back and an oval seat. A line joins the two backs, under the window.

left-legs.text: The left chair stands on three thin legs. Two short dashes between them show the shop's foot.

right-legs.text: Three legs for the right chair too, and two more dashes of ground.

cream.text: Cream for the walls, the chimney, the frames and ledges, three stripes and the tabletop.

red-blue.text: Red for the roof, the pots and four stripes. Blue for every pane of glass.

greens.text: Dark green for the shop front, green for the bushes. Orange for the chairs, the table leg and the flower box.

lesson-outro.text: Your café is open, from the chimney pots down to the chair legs. Go on, take the seat by the window.
